programme.title: Return Of The Mafia
programme.desc: Ten years after welcoming Dae-suh into their family, the Three-J clan leaves their mafia past behind to establish a construction company. However, when Dae-suh becomes president, the three brothers plot against him, fearing he’ll take over.

programme.title: The Scam

programme.title: Beautiful Audrey

programme.title: Cheer Up, Mr. Lee!

programme.title: Love 911
programme.desc: A doctor tries to woo a grieving, widowed firefighter in her attempt to get him to testify on her behalf in a medical malpractice case.

programme.title: The Suspect
programme.desc: Betrayed by his country, a North Korean agent escaped to South Korea in vengeance for his family, yet become the suspect of a homicide.

programme.title: The Exclusive: Beat The Devils Tattoo

programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides ("Nesting Dolls"), infantism ("King Baby"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido ("Snakes"). From the creative storytelling ("4x4") to the macabre ("Who Shot Sherlock?"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie ("Mea Culpa"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter ("Hollywood Brass"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode ("Grave Danger"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: Love Punch

As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Nuns Seasonal Calendar
programme.desc: In this episode, we learn about the spring dates of seimei and kokuu. The temple chefs show us how to make two seasonal specialties, yomogi rice cakes and bamboo shoots mixed with sansho leaves.

programme.title: The Masterpieces of Tsutaju
programme.desc: This miniseries presents the masterpieces of Tsutaju, a brilliant ukiyo-e producer of the Edo period. This episode spotlights ukiyo-e artist Sharakus debut work "The Actor Otani Oniji III as Edobei."

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family!
programme.desc: Mr. Stricts twins visit the barbababies. The barbababies organize a treasure hunt for the twins and enjoy the great outdoors. // The Barbapapas are off to a new adventure... in the garden. But living in nature is more complicated than they expected.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family!
programme.desc: Chemical sprays are making the countryside rosy! The Barbapapas build an aviary to protect sick birds. // When they see a beach covered with rubbish, the Barbapapa family decides to clean the beach and use the trash to make a miniature golf course.

programme.title: Baby Sharks Big Show!
programme.desc: Jealous of Baby Sharks popularity, Shadow rebrands the Wreck as his own personal amusement park. // When Baby Shark and friends are playing knights and royals, Vola wants to be more than just a princess.

programme.title: Baby Sharks Big Show!
programme.desc: When Hank accidentally takes an important treasure from Swimmy Hall, he goes on a sneaky mission to set things right.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize. // A rockslide leaves Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Ryder discovers Garby the goat stuck on a cliff edge! He attempts to rescue Garby but gets stranded and drops his Pup Pad!

programme.title: Rubble and Crew
programme.desc: After uncovering dinosaur bones, the pups decide to build a dinosaur museum! // When Omar the Mail Carrier breaks his foot, its up to the pups to make sure he can still deliver the mail by building ramps all over town.

programme.title: DORA
programme.desc: Boots and Dora journey to Banana Hill to bring Isa a Friendiversary gift - a flowerpot that Boots painted himself! // Dora and friends throw Swiper a surprise birthday party. On the way to the party, Swiper attempts to swipe his own surprise present.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family!
programme.desc: Barbabeau forgot to return his book to the library. As Mr Strict the librarian is visiting Barbapapa today, Barbabeau decides to run away. // Barbamama wants the barbababies to tidy their bedrooms. Theyre hiding to escape the drudgery.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family!
programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama return to the tree they were born under. Its in bad condition. They must rescue it quickly without disturbing the nearby animals. // Its the Barbababiess birthday. They all want to do something different with Barbapapa!

programme.title: Midnight Ruins
programme.desc: Fallen painter Cheng Zihao is asked to investigate the strange events that occurred during the rehearsal of a play "Song of the Night" by an old friend. This play was rehearsed by them in the past, and has brought him many pains and nightmares. As Cheng Zihao uncovers the truth, he is shocked by the same story of love and hate after so many years…

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Watch Me Kill
programme.desc: A ruthless assassin named Luciana is hired by a kingpin to murder a man with a valuable diamond. Complications ensue when Luciana stumbles upon a teenage girl who is held captive by the man, and the kingpin discovers that the diamond Luciana turned over is fake.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Robocop 2
programme.desc: In bankrupt Detroit, RoboCop battles a fanatical drug lord pushing a synthetic narcotic called Nuke while OCP engineers a monstrous successor unit using the cult leader's transplanted brain.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: A martial artist hunts a killer in a plague-infested urban dump of the future.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: A mercenary gets involved in a mission that threatens the lives of his kin. In order to succeed, he must break into one of the most well guarded prisons in Eastern Europe and free the son of the most notorious drug lord in the world today.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Prequel to the first Missing In Action, set in the early 1980s it shows the capture of Colonel Braddock during the Vietnam war in the 1970s, and his captivity with other American POWs in a brutal prison camp, and his plans to escape.

programme.title: The Equalizer (2014)
programme.desc: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Linguist Louise Banks leads a team of investigators when gigantic spaceships touch down around the world. As nations teeter on the verge of global war, Banks and her crew must find a way to communicate with the extraterrestrial visitors.

programme.title: 47 Ronin
programme.desc: A band of samurai sets out to avenge the death and dishonor of their master at the hands of a ruthless shogun.

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: The attempted assassination of the American President is told and re-told from several different perspectives.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP1
programme.desc: Starfleet must once again call on legendary Jean-Luc Picard after members of his former crew - Cristóbal Rios, Seven of Nine, Raffi Musiker, and Dr. Agnes Jurati - discover an anomaly in space that threatens the galaxy.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP2
programme.desc: Picard finds himself transported to an alternate timeline in the year 2400 where he must face one last trial orchestrated by his longtime nemesis Q.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP3
programme.desc: Picard and the crew travel back to 2024 Los Angeles in search of the one person who can help them identify the point at which time diverged.

programme.title: Underworld: Rise Of Lycans
programme.desc: A prequel centered on the origins of the centuries-old feud between the race of aristocratic vampires and their former slaves, the Lycans.

programme.title: Chronicle Mysteries: Recovered
programme.desc: A podcast host becomes interested in a cold-case disappearance, mostly because she and the victim had grown up together in their small town.

programme.title: Danika
programme.desc: In this psychological thriller, a mother's (Marisa Tomei) relentless nightmares spiral into terrifying premonitions as she fights to protect her children from unseen horrors lurking in their lives. Also starring Regina Hall.

programme.title: Robocop 3
programme.desc: Robocop saves the day once more. This time the half man/half robot takes on ruthless developers who want to evict some people on \"their\" land.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: In a violent and corrupt prison, decorated cop Louis Burke must infiltrate the jail to find answers to a number of inside murders. What he finds is a struggle of life and death tied in to his own past.

programme.title: The Man In the Iron Mask
programme.desc: The cruel King Louis XIV of France has a secret twin brother whom he keeps imprisoned. Can the twin be substituted for the real king?

programme.title: Direct Action
programme.desc: Frank Gannon, a veteran cop, is being hunted by his fellow police officers after they learned he has betrayed the brotherhood and exposed to the feds wide scale corruption of the LAPD. He has one day left to prove his case and survive.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: A stranger's arrival triggers one man's battle to save mankind.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Two veterans of the Bosnian War, one American, one Serbian, find their unlikely friendship tested when one of them reveals their true intentions.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Former cop Brian O'Conner is called upon to bust a dangerous criminal and he recruits the help of a former childhood friend and street racer who has a chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Jarhead: Law Of Return
programme.desc: Ronan, a fighter pilot and Israeli by Law of Return, is shot down and captured in Syria after a mission. As he's a US senator's son, a joint Israeli US squad's sent in to rescue Ronan within 36 hours.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP4
programme.desc: With time running out to save the future, Picard seeks out an old friend for help; Rios winds up on the wrong side of the law; Jurati makes a deal with the Borg Queen.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 Ep. 5
programme.desc: Picard discovers an important person from his past, Q continues his manipulation of the timeline, taking an interest in Dr. Adam Soong. Seven and Raffi attempt a daring rescue of Rios.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP6
programme.desc: Tallinn helps Picard and the crew infiltrate a gala on the eve of a joint space mission to protect an astronaut they believe is integral in restoring the timeline - Renee Picard; Kore makes a startling discovery about her father's work.

programme.title: Day Of The Dead
programme.desc: When a small Colorado town is overrun by the flesh hungry dead a small group of survivors try to escape in a last ditch effort to stay alive.

programme.title: Scared Alive
programme.desc: While filming on a remote island, a low-budget film cast and crew fall prey to a mysterious killer hellbent on making a real-life snuff horror film.

programme.title: The Order
programme.desc: A playboy criminal contacts his dad after stealing a Faberge egg. Later it seems his dad has gone missing in Israel so he heads there. His disappearance is linked to the religious sect: The Order. Lots of fight and chase scenes.

programme.title: Elephant White
programme.desc: An assassin is hired by a businessman to avenge the murder of his daughter by white slave traders in Thailand.

programme.title: Drive Angry
programme.desc: A vengeful father escapes from hell and chases after the men who killed his daughter and kidnapped his granddaughter.

programme.title: Death On The Border
programme.desc: Two determined women vie to escape their abusive relationships with a dirty Detective at rock bottom, determined to move sex trafficked girls over the Mexican border.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: When his mother dies, scandal-ridden ex-Olympian John Wright returns to a hometown that has not forgiven him.

programme.title: 4Got10
programme.desc: A drug deal goes bad, leaving bodies. A sheriff shoots his deputy for the money and a wounded amnesiac shoots the sheriff and escapes with $3,000,000. DEA investigates as does the drug lord dad of the dead deputy.

programme.title: Undisputed
programme.desc: When heavyweight champion George \"Iceman\" Chambers lands in prison, the resident gangster arranges a boxing match with the reigning prison champ.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: An American agent, under false suspicion of disloyalty, must discover and expose the real spy without the help of his organization.

programme.title: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Dean has PTSD after a wet-job gone bad in Bosnia. Waiting for his police girlfriend at a diner, some bad guys inject him with a hallucinogen. It sends him back to traumatic experiences in Bosnia and he reacts violently.

programme.title: Ride Along
programme.desc: Security guard Ben must prove himself to his girlfriend's brother, top police officer James. He rides along James on a 24-hour patrol of Atlanta.

programme.title: Dragonheart: Battle For The Heartfire
programme.desc: A dragon known as Drago tries to end the rivalry between a brother and sister, both having dragon-like powers, who are after the throne of their grandfather, while a new threat steals Drago's source of power.

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Thirty years after the ring of the first bell, Rocky Balboa comes out of retirement and dons his gloves for his final fight against the reigning heavyweight champ Mason 'The Line' Dixon.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP1
programme.desc: Starfleet must once again call on legendary Jean-Luc Picard after members of his former crew - Cristóbal Rios, Seven of Nine, Raffi Musiker, and Dr. Agnes Jurati - discover an anomaly in space that threatens the galaxy.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP2
programme.desc: Picard finds himself transported to an alternate timeline in the year 2400 where he must face one last trial orchestrated by his longtime nemesis Q.

programme.title: Star Trek Picard S2 EP3
programme.desc: Picard and the crew travel back to 2024 Los Angeles in search of the one person who can help them identify the point at which time diverged.

programme.title: Today You Die
programme.desc: A former thief who is trying to go straight seeks vengeance on those who framed him.

programme.title: The Enforcer
programme.desc: An enforcer has to sacrifice everything to save a young girl he has befriended from his femme fatale boss who is involved in cybersex trafficking.

programme.title: Fast Charlie
programme.desc: For twenty years, Charlie Swift has been a fixer and hitman for a mob boss named Stan. After a rival boss puts a hit on Stan and his crew, Charlie is the sole survivor. Charlie decides to avenge his friend.

programme.title: Notorious Nick
programme.desc: Nick Newell, a one-armed MMA fighter, gets a rare chance to fight for the lightweight championship. He strives to win for himself and all the other people in the world with physical challenges.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A rag tag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: A Perfect Gateaway
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers on a Hawaiian vacation discover that psychopaths are stalking and murdering tourists on the islands.

programme.title: State of the Union
programme.desc: An industrialist is urged to run for President, but this requires uncomfortable compromises on both political and marital levels.

programme.title: 1275 Days
programme.desc: 15-year-old Blake faces life in prison for felony murder after a botched home invasion. His single mom and girlfriend support his David vs. Goliath legal battle in Elkhart, Indiana, seeking a second chance.

programme.title: Sleeping Giant
programme.desc: While spending the summer in cottage country on the shores of Lake Superior, three teens cope with boredom by testing the limits of their experience.

programme.title: Bobbleheads: The Movie
programme.desc: When the toys' humans go \"AWOL,\" they must defend their home from unexpected guests, two uninvited intruders who hope to swap a new baseball player bobblehead for a valuable one.

programme.title: The Tiger Rising
programme.desc: A young boy discovers a caged tiger in the woods near his home.

programme.title: Lilly's Light: The Movie
programme.desc: When two curious members of Lilly's crew discover \"The Big Book of Little Adventures\" in the lighthouse basement, the adventure begins.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: The true story of Captain Richard Phillips and the 2009 hijacking by Somali pirates of the U.S.-flagged MV Maersk Alabama, the first American cargo ship to be hijacked in two hundred years.

programme.title: The Night Manager S1 EP5
programme.desc: Jonathan puts on an impressive display to persuade Roper of his loyalty; Burr finds her operation, and herself, under threat.

programme.title: The Night Manager S1 EP6
programme.desc: As Burr faces questions and drastically-reduced resources, Jonathan is pushed to the limit.

programme.title: The Night Manager S1 EP7
programme.desc: The night manager of a Cairo hotel is recruited to infiltrate an arms dealer's inner circle.

programme.title: The Night Manager S1 EP8
programme.desc: The night manager of a Cairo hotel is recruited to infiltrate an arms dealer's inner circle.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: A decidedly odd couple with ulterior motives convince Dr. Grant to go to Isla Sorna for a holiday, but their unexpected landing startles the island's new inhabitants.

programme.title: Milton's Secret
programme.desc: A young boy becomes the victim of bullying at his school.

programme.title: Southwest of Salem: The Story of the San Antonio Four
programme.desc: A documentary that follows the struggle for exoneration of four Latina lesbians who were wrongfully convicted of gang rape against two young girls.

programme.title: Bad Teacher
programme.desc: A lazy, incompetent middle school teacher who hates her job, her students, and her co-workers is forced to return to teaching to make enough money for breast implants after her wealthy fiancé dumps her.

programme.title: Five Nights In Maine
programme.desc: A young African American man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting guilt and grief over her daughter's death.

programme.title: Harry's Case
programme.desc: Once at the top of the heap, former Bay Street lawyer Harry Wolfe now scrapes out a living as an unregistered private investigator. A dis-barred loser in everyone's eyes, Harry clings to the shred of hope that he'll prove his law partners set him up to take the fall that destroyed his life.

programme.title: The Shallows
programme.desc: A mere 200 yards from shore, surfer Nancy is attacked by a great white shark, with her short journey to safety becoming the ultimate contest of wills.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out Of Water
programme.desc: When a diabolical pirate above the sea steals the secret Krabby Patty formula, SpongeBob and his friends team up in order to get it back.

programme.title: Blue Crush 2
programme.desc: Haunted by the memory of her deceased mother, Dana leaves Malibu behind and heads to South Africa to fulfill her mother's dream of surfing Jefferys Bay.
A frustrated writer struggles to keep his family alive when a series of global catastrophes threatens to annihilate mankind.

programme.title: Yellowjackets S2 Ep. 5
programme.desc: Rise and shine and don't forget your booties because it's coooold out there. Misty makes a leap of faith, Natalie and Lottie play a game, Shauna finds herself unexpectedly randy, and Tai seeks out a movie recommendation.

programme.title: Yellowjackets S2 Ep. 6
programme.desc: Trapped inside on a snow day, the Yellowjackets revisit the highlights, humiliations and traumas of Health Class. Tai and Van help each other rewind, while Misty explores joining a classic Cosmic American tribute band.

programme.title: Yellowjackets S2 Ep. 7
programme.desc: Out in the wilderness, Coach Scott does a great Karl Havoc impression for an unimpressed Misty.

programme.title: Yellowjackets S2 Ep. 8
programme.desc: Callie encounters an old flame, Van proves goalies never say die, most of the adults intentionally commune in the sharing shack.

programme.title: Yellowjackets S2 Ep. 9
programme.desc: Heavy is the head that wears the antler crown is a lesson you don't learn until much later in life... if you ever even learn it at all. Everything's about to get really wild(erness), and we're so excited (so excited!).

programme.title: Bring It On: In It to Win It
programme.desc: At Camp Spirit Thunder, high school cheer leaders compete. The red team/Sharks' cutie, Carson, and blue team/Jets' hunk, Penn, are in love. Does that make them archenemies like the Sharks and Jets?

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: Bumblebee teams up with a teenage girl to protect the world while the Decepticons hunt him with the help of a secret agency.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: A father and his seventeen-year-old daughter are living an ideal existence in a vast urban park in Portland, Oregon when a small mistake derails their lives forever.

programme.title: Obituary
programme.desc: A small-town obituarist resorts to murder when local work dries up.

programme.title: The Wedding Date
programme.desc: Single-girl anxiety causes Kat Ellis to hire a male escort to pose as her boyfriend at her sister's wedding. Her plan, an attempt to dupe her ex-fiancé, who dumped her a couple years prior, proves to be her undoing.

programme.title: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood
programme.desc: Lloyd Vogel, a cynical journalist, gets acquainted with a kind-hearted television presenter, Fred Rogers, while writing an article on him. With time, the two strike an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: A mysterious map sets Smurfette and her friends Brainy, Clumsy and Hefty on an exciting race through the Forbidden Forest, leading to the discovery of the biggest secret in Smurf history.

programme.title: Puppy Swap
programme.desc: A heartwarming family film about an engaged couple that adopts two puppies. When the couple splits up, the puppies hatch a plan to bring the two back together.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: A malfunction in a sleeping pod on a spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet wakes one passenger 90 years early.

programme.title: The Whistleblower
programme.desc: A drama based on the experiences of Kathryn Bolkovac, a Nebraska cop who served as a peacekeeper in post-war Bosnia and outed the U.N. for covering up a sex trafficking scandal.

programme.title: Captain Underpants
programme.desc: Two overly-imaginative pranksters hypnotize their grumpy principal into thinking he's a ridiculously enthusiastic, incredibly dimwitted, underwear-themed superhero.

programme.title: Boundaries
programme.desc: Laura and her son Henry are forced to drive her estranged, pot-dealing, carefree father Jack cross country after being kicked out of a nursing home.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: A physician who can talk to animals embarks on an adventure to find a legendary island with a young apprentice and a crew of strange pets.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: A failed reporter is bonded to an alien entity, one of many symbiotes who have invaded Earth. But the being takes a liking to Earth and decides to protect it.

programme.title: See S2 Ep. 1
programme.desc: Baba ventures into hostile territory in search of Haniwa. Queen Kane consecrates a new Payan capital and makes a surprising announcement.

programme.title: Yellowjackets S2 Ep.1
programme.desc: Two months into winter the survivors cope with falling rations, low morale and their latest disastrous attempt to freeze a teammate out of the game. Taissa, Misty and Natalie all seek out best friends, both old and new.

programme.title: Pineapple Express
programme.desc: A process server and his marijuana dealer wind up on the run from hitmen and a corrupt police officer after he witnesses his dealer's boss murder a competitor while trying to serve papers on him.

programme.title: Dope
programme.desc: Life changes for Malcolm, a geek who's surviving life in a tough neighborhood, after a chance invitation to an underground party leads him and his friends into a Los Angeles adventure.

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: A flamboyant law firm secretary works tirelessly to gain justice for a small town wrecked by a utility company's pollution.

programme.title: Cloudy With A Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: A local scientist is often regarded as a failure until he invents a machine that can make food fall from the sky. But little does he know that things are about to take a turn for the worst.

programme.title: The Daily Life Of A Middle-Aged Online Shopper in Another World
Mumbai Love
programme.desc: An Indian raised in the Philippines falls in love with a Filipina on business in Mumbai. She leaves unexpectedly, and he travels back to the Philippines to find her.

programme.title: Sin Island
programme.desc: It tells the story of David and Kanika who are happily married until Kanika's adulterous affair ruins their relationship, provoking David to start his own affair with Tasha.

programme.desc: DIVINA LAW: JESSUP.

programme.title: Room 213
programme.desc: Ten years into their marriage, an architect and his wife have lost all the spark in their relationship, and have grown apart from each other. In a tiny room in an abandoned building, they explore each other's boundaries, going to extreme lengths to rekindle what they once had.

programme.title: Stash House
programme.desc: Dave and Amy have found the perfect house, until they discover a stash of heroin and end up imprisoned in it by violent thugs.

programme.title: The Mechanik
programme.desc: A Russian ex-Spetsnaz working as a mechanic in LA accepts a job freeing a kidnapped woman in Saint Petersburg, as the mob boss also killed his wife and son 7 years ago. The body count begins.

programme.title: The Professor and the Madman
programme.desc: Professor James Murray begins work compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the 19th century, and receives over 10,000 entries from a patient at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum, Dr. William Minor.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A rag tag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: 4Got10
programme.desc: A drug deal goes bad, leaving bodies. A sheriff shoots his deputy for the money and a wounded amnesiac shoots the sheriff and escapes with $3,000,000. DEA investigates as does the drug lord dad of the dead deputy.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: A business man by day and criminal mastermind by night, Quinn Forte (Billy Zane) had it all: money, power, respect...until someone from his inner circle murdered his father and stole it all away.

programme.title: Castle Falls
programme.desc: Rival gangs seek out millions of dollars hidden inside a hospital that's scheduled to be demolished, but first they have to deal with the construction worker who found the loot first.

programme.title: Crank: High Voltage
programme.desc: Chelios faces a Chinese mobster who has stolen his nearly indestructible heart and replaced it with a battery-powered ticker which requires regular jolts of electricity to keep working.

programme.title: The Hive
programme.desc: When ants, displaying never-before-seen behavior, seize an island, the controversial Thorax Team is called to stop the massive threat only to discover that the ants are controlled by something beyond this world.

programme.title: The Curse of King Tut's Tomb
programme.desc: A free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the power to control the world. Unfortunately, the only one who believes Fremont is his nemesis archaeologist Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it.

programme.title: Room 203
programme.desc: Two best friends and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. Based on the novel published by Kobunsha and written by Nanami Kamon.

programme.title: Fear of Rain
programme.desc: A girl living with schizophrenia struggles with terrifying hallucinations as she begins to suspect her neighbor has kidnapped a child. The only person who believes her is Caleb - a boy she isn't even sure exists.

programme.title: Cabin Fever: Patient Zero
programme.desc: When a group of friends enjoying a bachelor cruise in the Caribbean stumble upon a research facility on a remote island, a deadly virus is unleashed. The group must find a way to survive before the flesh eating virus consumes them all.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father moves his two children to rural South Carolina, only to watch his daughter exhibit increasingly strange behavior.
